transparency.strip: We don’t show aggregated “whole platform” stats on the homepage — so you never have to wonder if they’re real or vanity metrics.
transparency.updated: This version of the homepage was generated at {time}.
transparency.isrNote: The page is rebuilt on a schedule (caching). The timestamp is when this snapshot was built — not a “live” market number.
transparency.sectionLead: We don’t want to sell you with figures you can’t verify. That’s why we avoid homepage claims like “X users online now” or “Y trades in the last hour” unless we can show exactly how they’re measured.
transparency.point1: No rolled-up platform statistics on the homepage that ask you to “just trust us”.
transparency.point2: If we show our own metrics later, we’ll state clearly what they measure and where they come from.
transparency.point3: Demos and paper trading are labelled as simulation or practice funds — never as guaranteed or real returns.
